name: Insta360 Studio Mod Suite
description: 2.4x Export Speedup (Denoise Bypass), Universal Custom LUT Support, Live LUT Switcher, and Unlocked Color Adjustments

patches.name: Denoise Bypass (2.4x Export Speedup)
patches.description: Bypasses internal multi-frame spatio-temporal denoiser, reducing export times by over 50% while preserving fine natural sensor grain.
patches.instructions_patched: xor eax, eax; ret; nop; nop; nop

patches.name: Export LUT Forwarding
patches.description: Forwards UI enable_lut flag [rsi+0xa2] directly to the export render pipeline [rsi+0x1fc], ensuring custom LUT is baked into exported MP4/ProRes.

patches.name: Universal LUT Engine Support
patches.description: Forces supportLut getter to return true (1), enabling the LUT rendering pipeline for all footage (Single Lens, 360, Flat, Non-Log).

patches.name: Media Load LUT Property Flag
patches.description: Sets the LUT property flag to true on media loading.

patches.name: Video Adjustments Unlock (filtersModifiable)
patches.description: Forces filtersModifiable to return true, decoupling color adjustments (Exposure, Saturation, Contrast, Color Plus) from the LUT toggle state.
patches.instructions_patched: mov al, 1; ret; nop; nop; nop

patches.name: Adjustment Reset Hook Bypass
patches.description: Bypasses the log footage callback that resets/zeroes out user color adjustments when LUT is toggled off.
patches.instructions_patched: ret; nop; nop; nop; nop; nop

patches.name: filtersModifiable Getter Unlock
patches.description: Forces MediaProcessViewModel::filtersModifiable getter to return true (1), preventing Studio from greying out or disabling color adjustments when LUT is toggled off.

patches.name: In-App Native LUT Selector Dropdown
patches.description: Embeds native ColumnLayout and Loader inside InsDrawer, enabling the expand arrow and rendering preset cards + look dropdown.
patches.instructions_patched: InsDrawer with ColumnLayout + Loader pointing to Public/L.qml
